topic: Under federal rule, colleges must leave grads better off or lose financial aid
headline: Colleges Must Improve Outcomes
caption:
As a full stack engineer, I see parallels between this policy shift and software development. Metrics matter - whether it's user engagement or graduation rates. This rule pushes colleges to prioritize real results, not just grades on paper. It’s like debugging a codebase until the user experience actually improves. Excited to see how data transparency influences educational quality - feedback loops are vital! If institutions adopt a more data-driven approach, we can better align effort and impact. How do you think tech can help colleges meet these new standards? 🚀
